svg.title: The review’s three positive human studies: two are retracted
svg.desc: The six human studies the October 19, 2026 review counts for efficacy. Review verdicts: 3 positive, 2 neutral, 1 interim. Status on October 20: the randomized Egyptian mebendazole trial in colorectal cancer stands, though its registry entry lists no masking and no placebo; the METRICS glioblastoma study was retracted October 13, 2026 after the UK regulator found it ran without proper ethics approval or consent; the 197-person ivermectin plus mebendazole survey of The Wellness Company customers was retracted October 1, 2026; the two neutral mebendazole studies missed their goals; the ivermectin breast cancer trial has only an interim readout. No study tested the two drugs together against a control group, and the review says no lab or animal study has tested the pair.
